title: A Generative Model-Free Form Deformation Approach for the Generation of Mesh Motions with Applications to PDE
summary: We introduce a topology-agnostic framework for matching deformations of three-dimensional shapes with non-isomorphic mesh graphs by modelling the deformation as the flow of an Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE). The velocity field is parameterised by a time-dependent Free Form Deformation (FFD), expressed through displacements of a coarse control lattice, yielding a smooth and low-dimensional representation that decouples the deformation model from the discretisation of the source and target surfaces.
